description: Pick any color and instantly get its HEX, RGB and HSL values with click-to-copy readouts, plus auto-generated shades, tints and a random color button.
howto: Use the color input or type a HEX value.
Read the HEX, RGB and HSL values below.
Click any readout to copy its value.
Explore auto-generated shades and tints, or hit Random.
title: Color Picker

faqs.q: What is the difference between HEX, RGB and HSL?
faqs.a: They are three ways to describe the same color: HEX is a compact code for web use, RGB lists red/green/blue amounts, and HSL describes hue, saturation and lightness.

faqs.q: How are the shades and tints made?
faqs.a: Shades mix the color toward black and tints mix it toward white in fixed steps, giving you a matching palette instantly.

faqs.q: Can I paste a color code from elsewhere?
faqs.a: Yes — type or paste any #RRGGBB (or 3-digit) HEX value into the text field and everything updates.
